units.literal: Fifth month, the Son of Heaven with Bingzhou's Taiyuan, Shangdang, Xihe, Leping, Xinxing, Yanmen, and Sizhou's Hedong, Pingyang—eight commanderies, territory seven hundred li square—enfeoffed the Emperor as Duke of Jin, added the nine bestowals, advanced position to Chancellor of State, and the Jin state set up offices.

units.zh: 九讓，乃止。
units.en: He demurred nine times before the offer was withdrawn.
units.literal: Nine times he declined; then it stopped.

units.zh: 於是增邑萬戶，食三縣，諸子之無爵者皆封列侯。
units.en: As consolation his fief rose by ten thousand households across three counties, and every son without a title was made a full marquis.
units.literal: Thereupon increased fief by ten thousand households, eating three counties; sons without noble rank were all enfeoffed full marquises.

units.zh: 秋七月，奏錄先世名臣元功大勳之子了，隨才敘用。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn he memorialized to enroll the sons of past worthies and of families that had earned great merit at the founding, and to place them according to ability.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, memorialized to record and employ the sons of former generations' famous ministers and of those who rendered founding merit and great service, according to talent arranging appointment.

units.zh: 四年夏六月，分荊州置二都督，王基鎮新野，州泰鎮襄陽。
units.en: In the sixth month of summer, the fourth year, Jingzhou was split into two commands: Wang Ji took Xinye and Zhou Tai took Xiangyang.
units.literal: Fourth year, summer, sixth month, divided Jingzhou and set up two area commands; Wang Ji garrisoned Xinye, Zhou Ta garrisoned Xiangyang.

units.zh: 使石苞都督揚州，陳騫都督豫州，鐘毓都督徐州，宋鈞監青州諸軍事。
units.en: He named Shi Bao over Yangzhou, Chen Qian over Yuzhou, Zhong Yu over Xuzhou, and Song Jun to oversee Qingzhou.
units.literal: He made Shi Bao area commander of Yangzhou, Chen Qian area commander of Yuzhou, Zhong Yu area commander of Xuzhou, Song Jun supervised Qingzhou military affairs.

units.zh: 景元元年夏四月，天子復命帝爵秩如前，又讓不受。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, Jingyuan year 1, the emperor repeated the old offer of rank and stipend; Sima Zhao refused once more.
units.literal: First year of Jingyuan, summer, fourth month, the Son of Heaven again ordered the Emperor noble rank and emolument as before; again he declined and did not accept.

units.zh: 天子既以帝三世宰輔，政非己出，情不能安，又慮廢辱，將臨軒召百僚而行放黜。
units.en: Cao Mao saw three generations of Simas hold the real power; unable to bear a throne that was hollow, and fearing deposition, he prepared to call the high ministers to the front hall and strike first.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven, because the Emperor's house had been chief ministers for three generations, government was not issuing from himself, inwardly could not be at peace, also feared deposition and humiliation, was about to ascend the gallery and summon the hundred officials and carry out dismissal.

units.zh: 五月戊子夜，使冗從僕射李昭等發甲於陵雲台，召侍中王沈、散騎常侍王業、尚書王經，出懷中黃素詔示之，戒嚴俟旦。
units.en: On the night of wuzi in the fifth month he had Li Zhao and others arm the guards at Lingyun Terrace, summoned Wang Chen, Wang Ye, and Director Wang Jing, drew a yellow silk edict from his breast, showed it to them, and ordered martial law until dawn.
units.literal: Fifth month, night of wuzi, he ordered Supernumerary Household Coachman Li Zhao and others to raise armor at Lingyun Terrace, summoned Palace Attendant Wang Chen, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Wang Ye, Director Wang Jing, produced from his bosom the yellow plain edict and showed them, martial law awaiting dawn.

units.zh: 沈、業馳告於帝，帝召護軍賈充等為之備。
units.en: Wang Chen and Wang Ye galloped to Sima Zhao with the news; he called Jia Chong and other guards to readiness.
units.literal: Chen and Ye galloped to inform the Emperor; the Emperor summoned Army Protector Jia Chong and others to prepare for it.

units.zh: 天子知事泄，帥左右攻相府，稱有所討，敢有動者族誅。
units.en: When Cao Mao saw the plot had leaked, he led his attendants against the chancellor’s palace, shouting a punitive purpose and threatening clan extinction on anyone who stirred.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven knew the affair had leaked; leading those at his left and right he attacked the chancellor's mansion, declaring there was something to punish; whoever dared move—clan execution.

units.zh: 相府兵將止不敢戰，賈充叱諸將曰：「公畜養汝輩，正為今日耳！」
units.en: The soldiers of the chancellor's office stopped and did not dare fight, so Jia Chong scolded the generals, "The duke raised and fed you precisely for today!"
units.literal: The soldiers of the chancellor's office stopped and did not dare fight, so Jia Chong scolded the generals, "The duke raised and fed you precisely for today!"

units.zh: 太子舍人成濟抽戈犯蹕，刺之，刃出於背，天子崩于車中。
units.en: Cheng Ji, a cadet of the heir apparent’s household, drove his spear through the imperial train; the blade passed clean through Cao Mao’s back, and the emperor died in his chariot.
units.literal: Crown Prince Household Attendant Cheng Ji drew spear and violated the imperial progress, stabbed him; the blade came out his back; the Son of Heaven died in the carriage.

units.zh: 帝召百僚謀其故，僕射陳泰不至。
units.en: Sima Zhao assembled the ministers to account for the killing, but Vice Director Chen Tai stayed away.
units.literal: The Emperor summoned the hundred officials to deliberate the reason; Vice Director Chen Tai did not arrive.

units.zh: 帝遣其舅荀顗輿致之，延于曲室，謂曰：「玄伯，天下其如我何？」
units.en: He sent his maternal uncle Xun Yi in a litter to fetch Chen Tai into a side room and asked, "Xuanbo, what is the realm going to say of me now?"
units.literal: The Emperor sent his maternal uncle Xun Yi in a litter to bring him, extended him in a side chamber, saying: "Xuanbo, what will all under Heaven do to me?

units.zh: 泰曰：「惟腰斬賈充，微以謝天下。」
units.en: Chen Tai answered, "Only cutting Jia Chong in two at the waist would begin to appease the empire."
units.literal: Tai said: "Only to waist-cut Jia Chong, slightly thereby to apologize to all under Heaven.

units.zh: 帝曰：「卿更思其次。」
units.en: Sima Zhao said, "Think of something short of that."
units.literal: The Emperor said: "You further think of the next.

units.zh: 泰曰：「但見其上。
units.en: Chen Tai said, "I only see the highest measure.
units.literal: Chen Tai said, "I only see the highest measure.

units.zh: 不見其次。」
units.en: I do not see the next best."
units.literal: I do not see the next best."

units.zh: 於是歸罪成濟而斬之。
units.en: Sima Zhao pinned the deed on Cheng Ji and had him executed.
units.literal: Thereupon attributed guilt to Cheng Ji and beheaded him.

units.zh: 太后令曰：「昔漢昌邑王以罪發為庶人，此兒亦宜以庶人禮葬之，使外內咸知其所行也。」
units.en: The empress dowager ordered, "Formerly, King Changyi of Han was exposed for crimes and made a commoner. This child also should be buried with the rites of a commoner, so that inside and outside all know what he did."
units.literal: The empress dowager ordered, "Formerly, King Changyi of Han was exposed for crimes and made a commoner. This child also should be buried with the rites of a commoner, so that inside and outside all know what he did."

units.zh: 殺尚書王經，貳於我也。
units.en: Execute Director Wang Jing for disloyalty to me.
units.literal: Kill Director Wang Jing—he was double toward me.

units.zh: 庚寅，帝奏曰：「故高貴鄉公帥從駕人兵，拔刃鳴鼓向臣所，臣懼兵刃相接，即敕將士不得有所傷害，違令者以軍法從事。
units.en: On gengyin, Sima Zhao memorialized, "The late Duke of Gaoguixiang led the soldiers who followed his carriage, drew blades, beat drums, and came toward your servant's place. Your servant feared that blades would meet, and immediately ordered the officers and soldiers not to inflict harm; those who violated the order would be handled according to military law.
units.literal: On gengyin, Sima Zhao memorialized, "The late Duke of Gaoguixiang led the soldiers who followed his carriage, drew blades, beat drums, and came toward your servant's place. Your servant feared that blades would meet, and immediately ordered the officers and soldiers not to inflict harm; those who violated the order would be handled according to military law.

units.zh: 騎督成倅弟太子舍人濟入兵陣，傷公至隕。
units.en: Cavalry inspector Cheng Cui’s brother Cheng Ji, a cadet of the heir’s household, plunged into the ranks and mortally wounded the duke.
units.literal: Cavalry Supervisor Cheng Cui's younger brother, Crown Prince Household Attendant Ji, entered the battle array, wounded the duke unto death.

units.zh: 臣聞人臣之節，有死無貳，事上之義，不敢逃難。
units.en: A minister owes single-minded loyalty unto death and must not shrink from danger in serving his lord.
units.literal: Your subject has heard that the integrity of a human minister is: there is death, no double loyalty; the righteousness of serving superiors: dare not flee hardship.

units.zh: 前者變故卒至，禍同發機，誠欲委身守死，惟命所裁。
units.en: When the crisis struck like a sprung trap, I was ready to lay down my life and await Heaven’s verdict.
units.literal: The former sudden change arrived as if calamity together loosed a trigger; truly wishing to cast away body and guard death, only as fate decrees cut.

units.zh: 然惟本謀，乃欲上危皇太后，傾覆宗廟。
units.en: Yet the plot itself aimed to threaten the empress dowager and overturn the dynastic shrines.
units.literal: Yet as for the root plot, then he wished above to endanger the empress dowager, overturn the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 臣忝當元輔，義在安國，即駱驛申敕，不得迫近輿輦。
units.en: As chief minister my duty was to steady the state; I sent order after order that no one press the imperial carriages.
units.literal: Your subject shamefully occupies chief minister; righteousness lies in pacifying the state; immediately repeatedly issued orders not to press near the imperial carriages.

units.zh: 而濟妄入陣間，以致大變，哀怛痛恨，五內摧裂。
units.en: Cheng Ji broke into the ranks on his own and brought on catastrophe; my grief and rage tear me apart within.
units.literal: Yet Ji rashly entered amid the array, thereby causing the great change; grief and pain, hatred and regret, the five viscera tear apart.

units.zh: 濟幹國亂紀，罪不容誅，輒收濟家屬，付廷尉。」
units.en: Cheng Ji disturbed the state and disordered the statutes; his crime cannot be contained by execution. I have therefore arrested Ji's household and sent them to the Commandant of Justice."
units.literal: Cheng Ji disturbed the state and disordered the statutes; his crime cannot be contained by execution. I have therefore arrested Ji's household and sent them to the Commandant of Justice."

units.zh: 太后從之，夷濟三族。
units.en: The Dowager approved, and Cheng Ji’s kin to the third degree were wiped out.
units.literal: The empress dowager followed it; exterminated Ji's three clans.

units.zh: 與公卿議，立燕王宇之子常道鄉公璜為帝。
units.en: With the high ministers he agreed to set Cao Huang, the Duke of Changdaoxiang and son of Prince Yu of Yan, on the throne.
units.literal: Together with dukes and ministers he deliberated, establishing Prince of Yan Yu's son, Duke of Changdaoxiang Huang, as emperor.

units.zh: 六月，改元。
units.en: In the sixth month the era name was changed.
units.literal: Sixth month, changed era name.

units.zh: 丙辰，天子進帝為相國，封晉公，增十郡，加九錫如初，群從子弟未侯者封亭侯，賜錢千萬，帛萬匹。
units.en: On bingchen the emperor named Sima Zhao chancellor and Duke of Jin, added ten commanderies, renewed the nine gifts, made every cousin and nephew not yet titled a village marquis, and granted ten million cash and ten thousand bolts of silk.
units.literal: On bingchen, the Son of Heaven advanced the Emperor to Chancellor of State, enfeoffed Duke of Jin, increased ten commanderies, added the nine bestowals as at first; group follow younger kin not yet marquis were enfeoffed village marquis; bestowed ten million cash, ten thousand bolts of silk.

units.zh: 固讓，乃止。
units.en: He declined until the court let the matter drop.
units.literal: Firmly declined; then it stopped.

units.zh: 冬十一月，吳吉陽督蕭慎以書詣鎮東將軍石苞偽降，求迎。
units.en: In the eleventh winter month Wu’s Jiyang garrison commander Xiao Shen wrote to Shi Bao pretending to defect and asking for an escort.
units.literal: Winter, eleventh month, Wu Jiyang Supervisor Xiao Shen with a letter went to General Who Guards the East Shi Bao feigning surrender, requesting to be welcomed.

units.zh: 帝知其詐也，使苞外示迎之，而內為之備。
units.en: Sima Zhao saw the ruse and told Shi Bao to feign acceptance while laying a trap within.
units.literal: The Emperor knew it was deceit; he ordered Bao outwardly to show welcoming them, while inwardly to prepare for it.

units.zh: 二年秋八月甲寅，天子使太尉高柔授帝相國印綬，司空鄭沖致晉公茅土九錫，固辭。
units.en: On jiayin in the eighth month of autumn, the second year, Gao Rou brought the chancellor’s seal and Zheng Chong the fief-map and nine gifts; Sima Zhao refused them again.
units.literal: Second year, autumn, eighth month, day jiayin, the Son of Heaven sent Grand Commandant Gao Rou to confer on the Emperor the chancellor's seal and ribbon, Minister of Works Zheng Chong to deliver the Duke of Jin fief-soil and nine bestowals; firmly declined.

units.zh: 三年夏四月，肅慎來獻楛矢、石砮、弓甲、貂皮等，天子命歸於大將軍府。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, the third year, Sushen envoys brought birch arrows, stone heads, arms, and sable skins; the emperor directed the tribute to the grand general’s residence.
units.literal: Third year, summer, fourth month, Sushen came to present birch arrows, stone arrowheads, bows, armor, sable pelts, and the like; the Son of Heaven ordered them returned to the Great General's mansion.

units.zh: 四年春二月丁丑，天子復命帝如前，又固讓。
units.en: On dingchou in the second month of spring, the fourth year, the emperor repeated the old honors; Sima Zhao refused again.
units.literal: Fourth year, spring, second month, day dingchou, the Son of Heaven again ordered the Emperor as before; again firmly declined.

units.zh: 三月，詔大將軍府增置司馬一人，從事中郎二人，舍人十人。
units.en: In the third month an edict added one major, two retainers, and ten gentlemen to the grand general’s staff.
units.literal: Third month, edict: Great General's mansion additionally establish one Major, two Retainers, ten Gentlemen.

units.zh: 夏，帝將伐蜀，乃謀眾曰：「自定壽春已來，息役六年，治兵繕甲，以擬二虜。
units.en: That summer, as he readied the Shu expedition, he told his council, "Six years have passed since Shouchun fell—six years we have spent forging arms to meet Wu and Shu.
units.literal: Summer, the Emperor was about to campaign against Shu; then he consulted the host saying: "Since settling Shouchun, we have rested corvée six years, drilled troops and repaired armor, in order to target the two bandits.

units.zh: 略計取吳，作戰船，通水道，當用千餘萬功，此十萬人百數十日事也。
units.en: A Wu campaign—building hulls and dredging channels—would swallow ten million man-days; a hundred thousand laborers would need months on end.
units.literal: Roughly calculating taking Wu, building war boats, opening water routes, ought to use more than ten million man-days of work; this is a matter of one hundred several tens of days for one hundred thousand men.

units.zh: 又南土下濕，必生疾疫。
units.en: The southern marshes breed sickness; an army would wilt there.
units.literal: Moreover southern soil is low and damp; surely sickness and pestilence will arise.

units.zh: 今宜先取蜀，三年之後，在巴蜀順流之勢，水陸並進，此滅虞定虢，吞韓並魏之勢也。
units.en: Better to take Shu first; three years later, riding the Yangzi current from Ba and Shu, we can move by water and land together—the old stratagem of swallowing the neighbor to fatten the conqueror.
units.literal: Now it is fitting first to take Shu; after three years, with Ba-Shu's down-current momentum, water and land advancing together—this is the momentum of destroying Yu and settling Guo, swallowing Han and annexing Wei.

units.zh: 計蜀戰士九萬，居守成都及備他郡不下四萬，然則餘眾不過五萬。
units.en: Shu lists ninety thousand troops, but forty thousand must hold Chengdu and the outlying commanderies—no more than fifty thousand can meet us in the field.
units.literal: Calculating Shu warriors ninety thousand; dwelling to guard Chengdu and garrison other commanderies not less than forty thousand; then the remaining host does not exceed fifty thousand.

units.zh: 今絆姜維於遝中，使不得東顧，直指駱穀，出其空虛之地，以襲漢中。
units.en: Pin Jiang Wei in Taozhong so he cannot shift east, then drive straight through Luogu into the empty heart of Hanzhong.
units.literal: Now pin Jiang Wei in Taozhong, causing him not to be able to look east; point straight to Luogu Valley, emerge in their empty hollow ground, to raid Hanzhong.

units.zh: 彼若嬰城守險，兵勢必散，首尾離絕。
units.en: If they hug the walls and cling to the defiles, their strength will splinter and van detach from van.
units.literal: If they gird the city and guard the peril, military momentum must scatter; head and tail are cut off.

units.zh: 舉大眾以屠城，散銳卒以略野，劍閣不暇守險，關頭不能自存。
units.en: Mass the army to storm the towns, send flying columns to scour the open country, and Jiange will have no time to hold the narrows while the Guan passes collapse on their own.
units.literal: Raise a great host to slaughter the city; scatter picked troops to sweep the wilds; Jiange will have no leisure to guard the peril; Guantou cannot preserve itself.

units.zh: 以劉禪之暗，而邊城外破，士女內震，其亡可知也。」
units.en: Liu Shan is a dull tool; once the frontier cracks and panic seizes the capital, his fall is a foregone conclusion."
units.literal: With Liu Shan's darkness, and border cities broken from without, gentlemen and ladies within shaken, its perishing can be known.

units.zh: 征西將軍鄧艾以為未有釁，屢陳異議。
units.en: Deng Ai, the western commander, argued there was no opening yet and kept filing objections.
units.literal: General Who Conquers the West Deng Ai thought there was not yet a crack, repeatedly presented divergent opinions.

units.zh: 帝患之，使主簿師纂為艾司馬以喻之，艾乃奉命。
units.en: Annoyed by Deng Ai’s foot-dragging, Sima Zhao made his chief clerk Shi Zuan Deng Ai’s major to talk sense into him; Deng then accepted the order.
units.literal: The Emperor worried about it, ordered Chief Clerk Shi Zuan to become Ai's Major in order to instruct him; Ai then received the command.

units.zh: 於是征四方之兵十八萬，使鄧艾自狄道攻姜維於遝中，雍州刺史諸葛緒自祁山軍于武街，絕維歸路，鎮西將軍鐘會帥前將軍李輔、征蜀護軍胡烈等自駱穀襲漢中。
units.en: He raised a hundred and eighty thousand men from every quarter: Deng Ai moved from Didao against Jiang Wei in Taozhong; Yongzhou Inspector Zhuge Xu marched from Qishan to Wujie to sever Jiang Wei’s retreat; Zhong Hui, General Who Guards the West, led Li Fu, Hu Lie, and the rest through Luogu against Hanzhong.
units.literal: Thereupon conscripted troops of the four quarters one hundred eighty thousand, ordered Deng Ai from Didao to attack Jiang Wei in Taozhong, Inspector of Yongzhou Zhuge Xu from Qishan to encamp at Wujie, cutting off Jiang Wei's return route, General Who Guards the West Zhong Hui leading Former General Li Fu, Shu Campaign Protector Hu Lie, and others from Luogu Valley to raid Hanzhong.

units.zh: 秋八月，軍發洛陽，大賚將士，陳師誓眾。
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn the host left Luoyang after rich gifts to the ranks, a full review, and oaths to the army.
units.literal: Autumn, eighth month, the army set out from Luoyang, greatly rewarded officers and soldiers, arrayed the host and swore the multitude.

units.zh: 將軍鄧敦謂蜀未可討，帝斬以徇。
units.en: General Deng Dun said Shu was not ripe for attack; Sima Zhao struck off his head as a warning.
units.literal: General Deng Dun said Shu could not be punished; the Emperor beheaded him to display.

units.zh: 九月，又使天水太守王頎攻維營，隴西太守牽弘邀其前，金城太守楊頎趣甘松。
units.en: In the ninth month he sent Tianshui’s Wang Qi against Jiang Wei’s camp, Longxi’s Qian Hong to block his van, and Jincheng’s Yang Qi toward Gansong.
units.literal: Ninth month, again ordered Tianshui Grand Administrator Wang Qi to attack Wei's camp, Longxi Grand Administrator Qian Hong to intercept his front, Jincheng Grand Administrator Yang Qi to hurry to Gansong.

units.zh: 鐘會分為二隊，入自斜谷，使李輔圍王含于樂城，又使步將易愷攻蔣斌于漢城。
units.en: Zhong Hui split his force, entered by Xie Valley, set Li Fu to invest Wang Han at Lecheng, and sent Yi Kai against Jiang Bin at Hancheng.
units.literal: Zhong Hui divided into two columns, entered from Xie Valley, ordered Li Fu to besiege Wang Han at Lecheng, also ordered infantry general Yi Kai to attack Jiang Bin at Hancheng.

units.zh: 會直指陽安，護軍胡烈攻陷關城。
units.en: Zhong Hui drove straight on Yang’an while Protector Hu Lie stormed the pass fort.
units.literal: Hui pointed straight to Yang'an; Protector Hu Lie attacked and took Guancheng.

units.zh: 姜維聞之，引還，王頎追敗維于強川。
units.en: Jiang Wei wheeled about; Wang Qi ran him down at Qiangchuan and broke his column.
units.literal: When Jiang Wei heard it, he led back; Wang Qi pursued and defeated Wei at Qiangchuan.

units.zh: 維與張翼、廖化合軍守劍閣，鐘會攻之。
units.en: Jiang Wei joined Zhang Yi and Liao Hua to hold Jiange; Zhong Hui laid siege.
units.literal: Wei joined Zhang Yi and Liao Hua combining armies to guard Jiange; Zhong Hui attacked it.

units.zh: 冬十月，天子以諸侯獻捷交至，乃申前命曰：
units.en: In the tenth winter month, as victory dispatches from the lords piled in, the emperor renewed his earlier charge, saying:
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, the Son of Heaven because the nobles' presented victories arrived in succession, then reiterated the former command saying:

units.zh: 朕以寡德，獲承天序，嗣我祖宗之洪烈。
units.en: We, though lacking in virtue, have received the Mandate and carry forward the great enterprise of our forebears.
units.literal: We, with scant virtue, have obtained to inherit Heaven's ordering, continuing our ancestors' and forebears' vast blazing merit.

units.zh: 遭家多難，不明於訓。
units.en: The house has suffered repeated trials, and We have not been equal to the lessons of rule.
units.literal: Encountering the house's many hardships, not clear in instruction.

units.zh: 曩者奸逆屢興，方寇內侮，大懼淪喪四海，以墮三祖之弘業。
units.en: Traitors rose again and again while enemies pressed inward; We feared the realm would slip away and the magnificent work of the three founders come to nothing.
units.literal: Formerly traitors and rebels repeatedly arose, border bandits inwardly insulted; greatly fearing the loss and ruin of the four seas, thereby toppling the three ancestors' grand enterprise.

units.zh: 惟公經德履哲，明允廣深，迪宣武文，世作保傅，以輔乂皇家。
units.en: You embody virtue and wisdom, clear-sighted and steadfast, carrying forward the civil and martial legacy; generation on generation your house has been tutor and bulwark to the throne.
units.literal: Only you thread virtue and tread wisdom, are enlightened, trustworthy, broad and deep; you enlighten and spread martial and civil; generation after generation you serve as protector and tutor, thereby assisting and governing the royal house.

units.zh: 櫛風沐雨，周旋征伐，劬勞王室，二十有餘載。
units.en: Through wind and rain you have marched and fought for the royal house more than twenty years.
units.literal: Combing wind and bathing rain, turning in campaigns and punishments, toiling for the royal house, more than twenty years.

units.zh: 毗翼前人，乃斷大政，克厭不端，維安社稷。
units.en: You stood beside Our predecessors, settled the great affairs of state, crushed every irregularity, and steadied the altars.
units.literal: Assisting wing the former men, then you judged great government, were able to quell what was not upright, tied and secured the altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 暨儉、欽之亂，公綏援有眾，分命興師，統紀有方，用緝寧淮浦。
units.en: When Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin rose, you calmed the armies, issued orders to march, kept discipline, and brought quiet again to the banks of the Huai.
units.literal: When it came to Jian and Qin's rebellion, you pacified and aided the hosts, separately ordered raising armies, ordering statutes had method, thereby used to bring peace to the Huai shores.

units.zh: 其後巴蜀屢侵，西土不靖，公奇畫指授，制勝千里。
units.en: When Ba and Shu raided again and again and the west would not stay still, your stratagems directed the hosts and won victories a thousand leagues away.
units.literal: Afterward Ba-Shu repeatedly encroached, the western land was not quiet; you with marvelous plans pointed and instructed, controlled victory a thousand li.

units.zh: 是以段谷之戰，乘釁大捷，斬將搴旗，效首萬計。
units.en: Hence at Duangu you seized the opening, won a crushing victory, struck down generals and hauled off their banners, and piled counted heads by the myriad.
units.literal: Therefore in the battle of Duangu, riding the crack you achieved a great victory, beheading generals and seizing banners, presenting heads by the ten thousands.

units.zh: 孫峻猾夏，致寇徐方，戎車首路，威靈先邁，黃鉞未啟，鯨鯢竄跡。
units.en: When Sun Jun troubled the heartland and raided Xu province, your host moved first and dread went before it; the golden yue had not yet been raised and the great beasts of Wu were already in flight.
units.literal: Sun Jun injured the central states, bringing bandits to Xu region; war chariots took the road first, awesome numen advanced first; the yellow battle-axe not yet opened, whales and calves fled their tracks.

units.zh: 孫壹構隙，自相疑阻，幽鑒遠照，奇策洞微，遠人歸命，作籓南夏，爰授銳卒，畢力戎行。
units.en: When Sun Yi’s faction turned on itself in mutual suspicion, your far-sighted plans split their counsels; distant peoples pledged allegiance and became a screen for the south, and you armed picked columns to finish the work in the field.
units.literal: Sun Yi built a rift, mutually suspecting and blocking; your dark mirror shone far, marvelous stratagems penetrated the subtle; distant men submitted their mandate, became fief at southern Xia; then you gave picked troops, exhausted strength on campaign.

units.zh: 暨諸葛誕，滔天作逆，稱兵揚楚，欽、咨逋罪，同惡相濟，帥其蝥賊，以入壽春，憑阻淮山，敢距王命。
units.en: Then Zhuge Dan rose in monstrous revolt, called arms along the Yangzi and Huai, drew Wen Qin and Tang Zi into his guilt, marched his rabble into Shouchun, and behind the Huai ranges defied the royal command.
units.literal: When it came to Zhuge Dan, he filled Heaven with rebellion, raised arms in Yang and Chu; Qin, Zi fled their crimes, joined evils aiding each other, led their mantis-bandits, thereby entering Shouchun, relying on Huai mountains' barrier, dared resist the king's command.

units.zh: 公躬擐甲胄，龔行在罰，玄謀廟算，遵養時晦。
units.en: You girded on mail yourself and led the punitive host; deep counsel from the temple and patience while Heaven’s hour was still dark.
units.literal: You personally donned helmet and armor, reverently marched in punishment; dark plans and temple calculations, followed and nurtured the season's obscurity.

units.zh: 奇兵震擊，而硃異摧破；
units.en: A sudden blow shattered Zhu Yi’s army;
units.literal: Odd troops quaking strike, and Zhu Yi was crushed and broken;

units.zh: 神變應機，而全琮稽服；
units.en: timely shifts of plan brought Quan Cong to humble submission;
units.literal: Spirit change responding to the moment, and Quan Cong bowed in submission;

units.zh: 取亂攻昧，而高墉不守。
units.en: you struck a foe in chaos and twilight until his high walls could not stand.
units.literal: Taking disorder and attacking darkness, and the high walls did not hold.

units.zh: 兼九伐之弘略，究五兵之正度，用能戰不窮武，而大敵殲潰；
units.en: You wielded the grand strategy of the nine campaigns and the full measure of the five arms, so that battle did not drain the army yet the great foe was wiped out;
units.literal: Combining the nine punishments' grand strategy, exhausting the five weapons' correct measure, thereby able to fight without exhausting martial force, while the great enemy was annihilated and routed;

units.zh: 旗不再麾，而元憝授首。
units.en: the standard scarcely had to wave again before the arch-traitor lost his head.
units.literal: The banner did not wave twice, while the chief villain delivered his head.

units.zh: 收勍吳之雋臣，系亡命之逋虜。
units.en: You took Wu’s able ministers captive and roped up every runaway.
units.literal: Collected Wu's stalwart ministers, bound fugitive fleeing captives.

units.zh: 交臂屈膝，委命下吏，俘馘十萬積屍成京。
units.en: They crossed arms, bent the knee, and threw themselves on your mercy; the slain and captive ran past a hundred thousand until corpses heaped like a hill.
units.literal: Crossing arms and bending knees, casting mandate to inferior clerks; captives and severed ears one hundred thousand, piled corpses formed a mound.

units.zh: 雪宗廟之滯恥，拯兆庶之艱難。
units.en: You washed away the lingering shame of the shrines and lifted the people out of mortal danger.
units.literal: Wiped the ancestral temple's stagnant shame, rescued the hundred million commoners' hardship and peril.

units.zh: 掃平區域，信威吳會，遂戢干戈，靖我疆土，天地鬼神，罔不獲乂。
units.en: You swept the land clear, carried awe to the Wu region, then put the weapons away and stilled Our borders until Heaven, earth, and the shades alike knew peace.
units.literal: Swept and leveled the regions, extended trust and awe to Wu and Hui; then gathered shields and spears, quieted Our border lands; Heaven and earth, ghosts and spirits, none did not obtain peace.

units.zh: 乃者王室之難，變起蕭牆，賴公之靈，弘濟艱險。
units.en: When calamity struck within the palace screen, it was your guiding hand that carried the throne through the peril.
units.literal: Then the royal house's hardship, change arose within the screen; relying on your numen, broadly crossed hardship and peril.

units.zh: 宗廟危而獲安，社稷墜而復寧。
units.en: The shrines tottered yet stood; the altars swayed yet steadied again.
units.literal: The ancestral temple was perilous yet obtained peace; the altars of soil and grain fell yet again were tranquil.

units.zh: 忠格皇天，功濟六合。
units.en: Your loyalty reaches to Heaven; your service braces the whole world.
units.literal: Loyalty penetrates August Heaven; merit succors the six directions.

units.zh: 是用疇咨古訓，稽諸典籍，命公崇位相國，加於群後，啟土參墟，封以晉域。
units.en: We have weighed the ancient precedents and the classics: We name you chancellor, set you above the other lords, and open the land of Sanxu as the state of Jin.
units.literal: Therefore We have questioned ancient instructions, examined the canons and records, ordered you to exalt position as Chancellor of State, added above the host of lords, opened soil at Sanxu, enfeoffed with the Jin domain.

units.zh: 所以方軌齊魯，翰屏帝室。
units.en: Thus you stand beside the great fiefs of Qi and Lu as a shield for the throne.
units.literal: By this means to parallel the tracks of Qi and Lu, be writing-screen to the imperial house.

units.zh: 而公遠蹈謙損，深履沖讓，固辭策命，至於八九。
units.en: Yet you have pressed humility to the utmost, refusing the patent of investiture eight or nine times running.
units.literal: Yet you far tread modest yielding, deeply tread humble decline, firmly decline investiture commands, reaching to eight or nine times.

units.zh: 朕重違讓德，抑禮虧制，以彰公志，於今四載。
units.en: We have long bent the rites to honor your modesty—four years now—yet the realm still lacks the fief your virtue deserves.
units.literal: We heavily violate yielding virtue, suppress rite and diminish regulation, in order to display your intent; until now four years.

units.zh: 上闕在昔建侯之典，下違兆庶具瞻之望。
units.en: Above, We fail the ancient model of enfeoffing merit; below, We frustrate the people’s universal expectation.
units.literal: Above it lacks the canon of establishing marquises of old; below it violates the hundred million commoners' all-gazing hope.

units.zh: 惟公嚴虔王度，闡濟大猷，敦尚純樸，省繇節用，務穡勸分，九野康乂。
units.en: You uphold the royal statutes, open great policy, prize simplicity, cut levies and waste, urge farming and fair shares, until the nine provinces thrive in peace.
units.literal: Only you sternly revere the king's measure, clarify and aid great plans, esteem and honor pure simplicity, reduce corvée and economize use, devote to harvest and encourage division, the nine fields are peaceful and governed.

units.zh: 耆叟荷崇養之德，鰥寡蒙矜恤之施，仁風興於中夏，流澤布於遐荒。
units.en: The aged enjoy your care, the lone and widowed your pity; a humane wind stirs in the heartland and your bounty reaches the farthest marches.
units.literal: Old men bear the virtue of exalted nurture; widowers and widows receive the application of pity and relief; humane wind rises in central Xia; flowing grace spreads to distant wastes.

units.zh: 是以東夷西戎，南蠻北狄，狂狡貪悍，世為寇讎者，皆感義懷惠，款塞內附，或委命納貢，或求置官司。
units.en: East and west, north and south, tribes long our foes now feel your justice and kindness; they crowd the passes with tribute or beg for offices under the throne.
units.literal: Therefore eastern Yi, western Rong, southern Man, northern Di—wild, cunning, greedy, fierce, generation after generation enemies—all are moved by righteousness and cherish kindness, knock the passes and attach within, or cast mandate and present tribute, or request to set up offices.

units.zh: 九服之外，絕域之氓，曠世所希至者，咸浮海來享，鼓舞王德，前後至者八百七十餘萬口。
units.en: Beyond the nine circuits, peoples no envoy had reached for ages sail the seas to pay homage; in all, more than eight million seven hundred thousand souls have come.
units.literal: Beyond the nine domains, the wastes' commoners, those rare to reach in ages, all float the seas to come offer, drum and dance the king's virtue; before and after, arrivals exceed eight million seven hundred thousand persons.

units.zh: 海隅幽裔，無思不服；
units.en: Even the hidden corners of the coast bend the knee without prompting;
units.literal: Sea corners and dark descendants, none think and do not submit;

units.zh: 雖西旅遠貢，越裳九譯，義無以逾。
units.en: not since the Western Hosts or the nine-tongued envoys of Yuechang has fealty run deeper.
units.literal: although Western Hosts' distant tribute, Yuechang's nine interpreters, in righteousness there is nothing to surpass.

units.zh: 維翼朕躬，下匡萬國，思靖殊方，寧濟八極。
units.en: You brace Our person and steady every kingdom, seeking peace in strange lands and calm to the ends of the earth.
units.literal: You wing Our person, below set aright the myriad states, think to quiet strange regions, pacify and succor the eight extremities.

units.zh: 以庸蜀未賓，蠻荊作猾，潛謀獨斷，整軍經武。
units.en: Because Shu and Jing still withhold allegiance, you laid secret plans, mustered the host, and set the army in order.
units.literal: Because Yong-Shu has not submitted, Man-Jing acts cunningly, you secretly plan alone and decide, array the army and regulate martial affairs.

units.zh: 簡練將帥，授以成策，始踐賊境，應時摧陷。
units.en: You picked and trained the commanders, gave them the finished plan, and the moment they set foot in enemy ground the foe collapsed.
units.literal: Selected and drilled generals and commanders, entrusted them completed stratagems; as soon as treading the bandit territory, in response to the moment smashed and fell.

units.zh: 狂狡奔北，首尾震潰，禽其戎帥，屠其城邑。
units.en: The enemy broke and ran; van and rear alike shattered; you took their generals and stormed their towns.
units.literal: The wild and cunning fled north; head and tail quaked and routed; captured their war leaders, slaughtered their cities and towns.

units.zh: 巴漢震疊，江源雲徹，地平天成，誠在斯舉。
units.en: Ba and Han trembled, the river’s source opened like parting clouds; earth and Heaven align—and the deed is yours.
units.literal: Ba and Han quaked in layers; Yangtze's source clouds cleared; earth level, Heaven completed—sincerity lies in this undertaking.

units.zh: 公有濟六合之勳，加以茂德，實總百揆，允厘庶政。
units.en: You have saved the realm and added brilliant virtue; you truly hold every rein of state and set all affairs straight.
units.literal: You have merit of succoring the six directions, added to luxuriant virtue; truly you overall command the hundred handles, truly you regulate the multitude of government.

units.zh: 敦五品以崇仁，恢六典以敷訓。
units.en: You nurture the five relationships toward humanity and spread the six statutes as the model for all.
units.literal: You urge the five grades to exalt benevolence; you enlarge the six canons to spread instruction.

units.zh: 而靖恭夙夜，勞謙昧旦，雖尚父之左右文武，周公之勤勞王家，罔以加焉。
units.en: Yet you rise in still reverence before dawn, humble in every task—not even the Grand Duke’s pairing of civil and martial, nor the Duke of Zhou’s zeal for the house, surpasses you.
units.literal: Yet you are calm and reverent from dawn to dusk, laboring humbly before daylight; even Shangfu’s support in civil and military affairs and the Duke of Zhou’s toil for the royal house did not surpass it.

units.zh: 昔先王選建明德，光啟諸侯，體國經野，方制五等。
units.en: The ancient kings chose men of bright virtue, opened fiefs for the lords, mapped state and wilderness, and fixed the five orders of nobility.
units.literal: In the past former kings selected and established bright virtue, broadly opened the feudal lords, embodied the state and regulated the wilds, thereby squared and established the five ranks.

units.zh: 所以籓翼王畿，垂祚百世也。
units.en: Thus they shielded the royal domain and laid up fortune for a hundred generations.
units.literal: By this means to screen and wing the royal domain, let blessings hang a hundred generations.

units.zh: 故齊魯之封，于周為弘，山川土田，邦畿七百，官司典策，制殊群後。
units.en: The grants to Qi and Lu were the greatest of Zhou: seven hundred li of hills, streams, and fields, with statutes and offices that set them apart from every other fief.
units.literal: Therefore Qi and Lu's enfeoffments, for Zhou were great; mountains, rivers, soil, fields—state domain seven hundred; offices, canons, and records—regulations differed from the host of lords.

units.zh: 惠襄之難，桓文以翼戴之勞，猶受錫命之禮，咸用光疇大德，作范於後。
units.en: During the crises of Kings Hui and Xiang, Dukes Huan and Wen, for their work in protecting and supporting the throne, still received the rites of conferral; all this made the great virtue of earlier times shine as a model for later ages.
units.literal: In Hui and Xiang's hardship, Huan and Wen by wing-and-cap labor still received the rite of bestowed commands; all used to brighten former great virtue, make model for later.

units.zh: 惟公功邁於前烈，而賞闕於舊式，百辟於邑，人神同恨焉，豈可以公謙沖而久淹弘典哉？
units.en: Your deeds outshine the old exemplars, yet the old scale of reward has been withheld; lords and spirits alike chafe—can We forever hide the great statutes behind your modesty?
units.literal: Only your merit surpasses former blazing deeds, yet reward lacks in old pattern; the hundred lords are anxious, man and spirit together resent—how can it be that because you are humble and yielding the grand canons are long submerged?

units.zh: 今以并州之太原上党西河樂平新興雁門、司州之河東平陽弘農、雍州之馮翊凡十郡，南至於華，北至於陘，東至於壺口，西逾於河，提封之數，方七百里，皆晉之故壤，唐叔受之，世作盟主，實紀綱諸夏，用率舊職。
units.en: We now grant ten commanderies—six of Bingzhou plus Hedong, Pingyang, Hongnong, and Fengyi—from Mount Hua in the south to Xing in the north, from Hukou in the east to the great River in the west, seven hundred li square: the ancient domain of Jin where Tang Shu once ruled as covenant lord of the Xia states. Take again that old charge.
units.literal: Now with Bingzhou's Taiyuan, Shangdang, Xihe, Leping, Xinxing, Yanmen, and Sizhou's Hedong, Pingyang, Hongnong, and Yongzhou's Fengyi—altogether ten commanderies, south reaching to Hua, north reaching to Xing, east reaching to Hukou, west crossing beyond the River, the lifted-enclosure count, square seven hundred li—all are Jin's former soil, Tang Shu received it, generation after generation served as covenant lord, truly regulated the various Xia, thereby to follow old duties.

units.zh: 爰胙茲土，封公為晉公。
units.en: We therefore invest this soil and name you Duke of Jin.
units.literal: Therefore enfeoff this soil, enfeoff you as Duke of Jin.

units.zh: 命使持節、兼司徒、司隸校尉陔即授印綬策書，金獸符第一至第五，竹使符第一至第十。
units.en: We order Gai, Bearer of Credentials, concurrent Minister of Education and Metropolitan Commandant, to confer at once the seal and ribbon, the patent, gold beast tallies one through five, and bamboo envoy tallies one through ten.
units.literal: Order Bearer of Credentials, concurrently Minister of Education, Metropolitan Commandant Gai to confer at once the seal-ribbon and patent text, gold beast tallies first through fifth, bamboo envoy tallies first through tenth.

units.zh: 錫茲玄土，苴以白茅，建爾國家，以永籓魏室。
units.en: We grant you this black earth bound with white rushes; found your state and be a lasting shield for Wei.
units.literal: Bestow this dark soil, wrap with white rushes, establish your state and house, thereby forever to screen the Wei house.

units.zh: 昔在周召，並以公侯，入作保傅。
units.en: Of old the dukes of Zhou and Shao entered court as dukes and marquises to serve as regents.
units.literal: In the past at Zhou and Shao, both by duke and marquis rank, entered to serve as protector and tutor.

units.zh: 其在近代，酂侯蕭何，實以相國，光尹漢朝。
units.en: In later ages Marquis Xiao He as chancellor lit the Han court with his rule.
units.literal: In recent times, Marquis of Zan Xiao He, truly by minister of state, brightly governed Han court.

units.zh: 隨時之制，禮亦宜之。
units.en: Rites shift with the times, and this grant fits the hour.
units.literal: Following the season's regulation, rite also fits it.

units.zh: 今進公位為相國，加綠綟綬。
units.en: We now advance you to chancellor and add the green-and-black ribbon of that office.
units.literal: Now advance your position to Chancellor of State, add green-and-black ribbon.

units.zh: 又加公九錫，其敬聽後命。
units.en: We add the nine gifts; hear now the items that follow.
units.literal: Again add to you the nine bestowals; respectfully listen to the later commands.

units.zh: 以公思弘大猷，崇正典禮，儀刑作範，旁訓四方，是用錫公大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。
units.en: Because you widen great policy, uphold the rites, and set the pattern for the four quarters, We grant you the state chariot and the war chariot, each with a team of four black stallions.
units.literal: Because you think to enlarge great plans, exalt and correct canons and rites, model and make pattern, broadly instruct the four quarters, therefore We bestow on you great chariot and war chariot each one, dark male teams two four-horse teams.

units.zh: 公道和陰陽，敬授人時，嗇夫反本，農殖維豐，是用錫公袞冕之服，赤舄副焉。
units.en: Because you harmonize Yin and Yang, set the calendar, and send farmers back to the soil until the harvests run rich, We grant the sacral robes and crown with the red court shoes.
units.literal: You harmonize Yin and Yang, reverently grant men their seasons; farmers return to root, farming increase is luxuriant; therefore We bestow on you robe and crown of state, red slippers accompanying.

units.zh: 公光敷顯德，惠下以和，敬信思順，庶尹允諧，是用錫公軒懸之樂、六佾之舞。
units.en: Because your virtue shines abroad and every office moves in harmony, We grant you the graded bells and the six rows of dancers.
units.literal: You brightly spread manifest virtue, show kindness below with harmony, reverent trust thinks compliance; myriad directors truly harmonize; therefore We bestow on you suspended hall music and six-row dance.

units.zh: 公鎮靖宇宙，翼播聲教，海外懷服，荒裔款附，殊方馳義，諸夏順軌，是用錫公硃戶以居。
units.en: Because you still the world and carry civilization to the seas, until distant lands submit, We grant vermilion lacquer for your gates.
units.literal: You pacify and quiet the cosmos within the four seas, wing and spread sound and teaching; beyond the seas they cherish submission; distant wastes knock in attachment; strange regions gallop righteousness; the various Xia follow the track; therefore We bestow on you vermilion doors to dwell.

units.zh: 公簡賢料材，營求俊逸，爰升多士，置彼周行，是用錫公納陛以登。
units.en: Because you choose the able and set them in the king’s highway, We grant the inner stair by which you mount the hall.
units.literal: You select worthies and measure talent, seek and recruit outstanding; then raise many gentlemen, set them in that Zhou road; therefore We bestow on you inner stair to ascend.

units.zh: 公嚴恭寅畏，底平四國，式遏寇虐，苛厲不作，是用錫公武賁之士三百人。
units.en: Because you awe the four quarters and stop cruelty without harshness, We grant three hundred picked guards of the martial escort.
units.literal: You sternly revere and fear respectfully, settle and level the four states, pattern-block bandit cruelty; harsh severity does not arise; therefore We bestow on you three hundred martial fierce gentlemen.

units.zh: 公明慎用刑，簡恤大中，章厥天威，以糾不虔，是用錫公鈇鉞各一。
units.en: Because you use punishments with care and display Heaven’s awe against the impious, We grant the execution axe and the ceremonial yue.
units.literal: You are enlightened and cautious in employing punishments, select and pity the great center, display that Heaven's majesty, thereby to correct what is not reverent; therefore We bestow on you axe and yue each one.

units.zh: 公爰整六軍，典司征伐，犯命淩正，乃維誅殛，是用錫公彤弓一、彤矢百，玈弓十、玈矢千。
units.en: Because you command the six hosts and strike down every violator of the king’s command, We grant the red bow with a hundred arrows and ten black bows with a thousand shafts.
units.literal: You then array the six armies, take charge of campaigning and punishing; those who violate commands and encroach the upright, then are to be executed and slain; therefore We bestow on you one red bow, one hundred red arrows, ten black bows, one thousand black arrows.

units.zh: 公饗祀蒸蒸，孝思維則，篤誠之至，通於神明，是用錫公秬鬯一卣，圭瓚副焉。
units.en: Because your ancestral rites rise in steam and your filial heart moves the spirits, We grant a jar of dark ale with the jade libation spoon.
units.literal: You feast-sacrifice steaming, filial thought takes them as model; utmost sincere arrival penetrates to spirits and gods; therefore We bestow on you one you of black millet ale, jade ladle accompanying.

units.zh: 晉國置官司以下，率由舊式。
units.en: The offices of the state of Jin shall follow the old forms.
units.literal: For the Jin state, establishing offices downward, all follow old pattern.

units.zh: 往欽哉！
units.en: Go—and be reverent!
units.literal: Go, reverently!

units.zh: 祗服朕命，弘敷訓典，光澤庶方，永終爾明德，丕顯餘一人之休命。
units.en: Accept Our charge, spread the teaching, bring light to every quarter, let your bright virtue endure, and magnify this sovereign’s gracious word.
units.literal: Reverently submit to Our command, broadly spread instruction and canons, brighten and moisten the myriad regions, eternally end your bright virtue, greatly display Our solitary person's fine command.

units.zh: 公卿將校皆詣府喻旨，帝以禮辭讓。
units.en: The high ministers and commanders crowded his gate with the edict; he declined again by formal courtesy.
units.literal: Dukes, ministers, generals, and colonels all went to the mansion to explain the intent; the Emperor by rite declined.

units.zh: 司空鄭沖率群官勸進曰：「伏見嘉命顯至，竊聞明公固讓，沖等眷眷，實有愚心。
units.en: Minister of Works Zheng Chong led the assembled officials in urging advancement, saying, "We humbly see that the fine command has manifestly arrived, and privately hear that your enlightened lordship firmly declines it. Chong and the others are full of concern and truly have a foolish thought.
units.literal: Minister of Works Zheng Chong led the assembled officials in urging advancement, saying, "We humbly see that the fine command has manifestly arrived, and privately hear that your enlightened lordship firmly declines it. Chong and the others are full of concern and truly have a foolish thought.

units.zh: 以為聖王作制，百代同風，褒德賞功，有自來矣。
units.en: The sage kings set precedent for every age: to honor merit is the way of antiquity itself.
units.literal: We consider that the sage king makes institutions; a hundred generations share one wind; praising virtue and rewarding merit has had its source from of old.

units.zh: 昔伊尹，有莘氏之媵臣耳，一佐成湯，遂荷阿衡之號。
units.en: Yi Yin began as a mere attendant of Youxin; one service to Tang won him the name Ah Heng.
units.literal: In the past Yi Yin was only Youxin's accompanying minister; once he assisted Cheng Tang, then he bore the title of Ah Heng.

units.zh: 周公藉已成之勢，據既安之業，光宅曲阜，奄有龜蒙。
units.en: The Duke of Zhou took power already won and a realm already calm, then made Qufu his seat and held Gui and Meng.
units.literal: The Duke of Zhou leaned on already completed power, occupied already secure enterprise, brightly dwelt at Qufu, covered Gui and Meng.

units.zh: 呂尚，磻溪之漁者也，一朝指麾，乃封營丘。
units.en: Lü Shang was a fisherman by Pan Creek; one morning’s command won him Yingqiu.
units.literal: Lü Shang was a fisherman of Panxi; one morning directing and waving, then was enfeoffed at Yingqiu.

units.zh: 自是以來，功薄而賞厚者，不可勝數，然賢哲之士，猶以為美談。
units.en: Since then thin merit has often drawn rich reward—yet wise men still praise those tales.
units.literal: From this onward, those whose merit was thin yet reward was thick cannot be counted; yet worthy and wise gentlemen still take them as fine tales.

units.zh: 況自先相國以來，世有明德，翼輔魏室，以綏天下，朝無秕政，人無謗言。
units.en: From the former Chancellor of State onward, each generation has aided Wei with shining virtue until the court is clean of chaff and the people free of slander.
units.literal: Moreover since the former Chancellor of State, generation after generation there has been bright virtue, winging and assisting the Wei house, thereby pacifying all under Heaven; court has no chaff government, men have no slanderous words.

units.zh: 前者明公西征靈州，北臨沙漠，榆中以西，望風震服，羌戎來馳，回首內向，東誅叛逆，全軍獨克。
units.en: You marched west to Lingzhou and north to the sands; west of Yuzhong every tribe trembled into submission; Qiang and Rong wheeled their horses toward the throne; in the east you cut down rebels alone and whole.
units.literal: Formerly the enlightened lord west campaigned Lingzhou, north faced the desert; west of Yuzhong, gazing at the wind trembled and submitted; Qiang and Rong came galloping, turned head inward; east punished rebels and traitors, whole army alone overcame.

units.zh: 禽闔閭之將，虜輕銳之卒以萬萬計，威加南海，名懾三越，宇內康寧，苛慝不作。
units.en: You took Wu’s generals and tens of thousands of their best troops, spread terror to the Southern Sea and the three Yues, and brought peace so that cruelty died away.
units.literal: Captured Helü's generals, took light keen soldiers by the ten thousands counted; awe added to South Sea, name overawed the three Yues; within the four seas peaceful and tranquil, harsh evil did not arise.

units.zh: 是以時俗畏懷，東夷獻舞。
units.en: The age stands in awe; even the eastern Yi send dancers to your court.
units.literal: Therefore the age's customs feared and cherished; eastern Yi presented dance.

units.zh: 故聖上覽乃昔以來禮典舊章，開國光宅，顯茲太原。
units.en: Therefore the sage Son of Heaven has weighed the old statutes and opened a bright fief for you at Taiyuan.
units.literal: Therefore the sage superior surveys thence past rites and canons, old regulations, opens state and bright dwelling, displays this Taiyuan.

units.zh: 明公宜承奉聖旨，受茲介福，允當天人。
units.en: You should accept the imperial word, take this great blessing, and satisfy both Heaven and the people.
units.literal: The enlightened lord ought to receive and follow the sage decree, receive this great blessing, truly meet Heaven and men.

units.zh: 元功盛勳，光光如彼；
units.en: Your founding merit shines so bright;
units.literal: Founding merit and blazing achievement, blazingly thus;

units.zh: 國土嘉祚，巍巍如此。
units.en: the fief and fortune offered you stand so high.
units.literal: State soil and fine blessing, thus lofty.

units.zh: 內外協同，靡愆靡違。
units.en: Within and without all move as one, without fault or breach.
units.literal: Inner and outer join in harmony; none fault, none violate.

units.zh: 由斯征伐，則可朝服濟江，掃除吳會，西塞江源，望祀岷山。
units.en: With that you may cross the Yangzi in court dress, sweep Wu clean, seal the river’s upper course, and offer the rite on Mount Min.
units.literal: From this campaigning, then can in court robes cross the Yangtze, sweep and clear Wu and Hui, west block Yangtze's source, gaze-sacrifice Mount Min.

units.zh: 回戈弭節，以麾天下，遠無不服，邇無不肅。
units.en: Then lay by spear and still the reins to command the realm until the far submit and the near stand in awe.
units.literal: Turn halberd and still the baton, thereby to command all under Heaven; far none not submit, near none not solemn.

units.zh: 令大魏之德，光于唐虞；
units.en: Great Wei’s virtue will outshine Tang and Yu;
units.literal: Let great Wei's virtue shine on Tang and Yu;

units.zh: 明公盛勳，超于桓文。
units.en: and your merit will rise above Huan and Wen.
units.literal: the enlightened lord's blazing merit surpasses Huan and Wen.

units.zh: 然後臨滄海而謝支伯，登箕山而揖許由，豈不盛乎！
units.en: Then you might stand by the eastern sea as kings of old did before worthy recluses, or climb Mount Ji to salute Xu You—what could be more glorious!
units.literal: Then facing the dark sea and thanking Zhibo, ascending Mount Ji and bowing to Xu You—is it not grand!

units.zh: 至公至平，誰與為鄰，何必勤勤小讓也哉。」
units.en: With utmost publicness and utmost fairness, who can be your neighbor? Why must you earnestly make this small refusal?"
units.literal: With utmost publicness and utmost fairness, who can be your neighbor? Why must you earnestly make this small refusal?"

units.zh: 帝乃受命。
units.en: Sima Zhao then accepted.
units.literal: The Emperor then received the command.

units.zh: 十一月，鄧艾帥萬餘人自陰平逾絕險至江由，破蜀將諸葛瞻於綿竹，斬瞻，傳首。
units.en: In the eleventh month Deng Ai took ten thousand men over the sheer track from Yinping to Jiangyou, crushed Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu, struck off his head, and sent it east by post.
units.literal: Eleventh month, Deng Ai led more than ten thousand from Yinping crossing extreme peril to reach Jiangyou, defeated Shu general Zhuge Zhan at Mianzhu, beheaded Zhan, sent the head by relay.

units.zh: 進軍雒縣，劉禪降。
units.en: He pushed on to Luo county, and Liu Shan yielded.
units.literal: Advanced the army to Luo county; Liu Shan surrendered.

units.zh: 天子命晉公以相國總百揆，於是上節傳，去侍中、大都督、錄尚書之號焉。
units.en: The emperor named the Duke of Jin chancellor with full authority over the government; Sima Zhao thereupon returned his batons and dropped the concurrent titles of Palace Attendant, Grand Commander-in-Chief, and overseer of the Secretariat.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven ordered the Duke of Jin by Chancellor of State to overall command the hundred handles; thereupon he submitted credentials and tallies, removed Palace Attendant, Grand Commander-in-Chief, and recording Director of the Secretariat titles.

units.zh: 表鄧艾為太尉，鐘會為司徒。
units.en: He recommended Deng Ai for Grand Commandant and Zhong Hui for Minister of Education.
units.literal: He memorialized Deng Ai as Grand Commandant, Zhong Hui as Minister of Education.

units.zh: 會潛謀叛逆，因密使譖艾。
units.en: Zhong Hui plotted revolt in secret and sent agents to traduce Deng Ai.
units.literal: Hui secretly plotted rebellion, thereby secretly sent to slander Ai.

units.zh: 咸熙元年春正月，檻車征艾。
units.en: In the first month of spring, Xianxi year 1, Deng Ai was summoned back in a prison cart.
units.literal: First year of Xianxi, spring, first month, caged cart summoned Ai.

units.zh: 乙丑，帝奉天子西征，次於長安。
units.en: On yichou he escorted the emperor west and encamped at Chang’an.
units.literal: On yichou, the Emperor escorting the Son of Heaven west campaigned, halted at Chang'an.

units.zh: 是時魏諸王侯悉在鄴城，命從事中郎山濤行軍司事，鎮於鄴，遣護軍賈充持節、督諸軍，據漢中。
units.en: With every Wei prince gathered at Yecheng, he put Shan Tao in charge of rear-area command there and sent Jia Chong with baton to oversee the armies holding Hanzhong.
units.literal: At this time Wei various princes and marquises were all at Yecheng; he ordered Retainer Shan Tao to conduct army affairs, garrisoning at Yecheng; sent Army Protector Jia Chong bearing credentials, supervising the various armies, occupying Hanzhong.

units.zh: 鐘會遂反於蜀，監軍衛瓘、右將軍胡烈攻會，斬之。
units.en: Zhong Hui rose in Shu; Wei Guan and Hu Lie struck him down and took his head.
units.literal: Zhong Hui then rebelled in Shu; Army Supervisor Wei Guan, General of the Right Hu Lie attacked Hui, beheaded him.

units.zh: 初，會之伐蜀也，西曹屬邵悌言於帝曰：「鐘會難信，不可令行。」
units.en: At first, when Zhong Hui was attacking Shu, Shao Ti, subordinate of the Western Bureau, said to Sima Zhao, "Zhong Hui is hard to trust; he must not be allowed to go."
units.literal: At first, when Zhong Hui was attacking Shu, Shao Ti, subordinate of the Western Bureau, said to Sima Zhao, "Zhong Hui is hard to trust; he must not be allowed to go."

units.zh: 帝笑曰：「取蜀如指掌，而眾人皆言不可，唯會與吾意同。
units.en: Sima Zhao had only smiled and said, "Shu will fall as easily as reading one’s palm, though everyone else doubted—only Zhong Hui shared my view.
units.literal: The Emperor smiled and said: "Taking Shu is like pointing at the palm; yet the host of men all say it cannot be done; only Hui and Our intent agree.

units.zh: 滅蜀之後，中國將士，人自思歸，蜀之遺黎，猶懷震恐，縱有異志，無能為也。」
units.en: After Shu fell, every northern soldier would pine for home and the Shu populace would still quake with fear—even if someone harbored treason, he could do nothing with it."
units.literal: After extinguishing Shu, central state's officers and soldiers, each person thinks of returning; Shu's surviving common people still cherish trembling fear; even if they had different intent, they have no ability to act.

units.zh: 卒如所量。
units.en: Events proved him exactly right.
units.literal: In the end it was as he had measured.

units.zh: 丙辰，帝至自長安。
units.en: On bingchen he returned from Chang’an to the capital.
units.literal: On bingchen, the Emperor arrived from Chang'an.

units.zh: 三月己卯，進帝爵為王，增封並前二十郡。
units.en: On jimao in the third month he was raised from duke to king with twenty commanderies in all, old grants and new.
units.literal: Third month, day jimao, advanced the Emperor's noble rank to king, increased fief together with the previous twenty commanderies.

units.zh: 夏五月癸未，天子追加舞陽宣文侯為晉宣王，舞陽忠武侯為晉景王。
units.en: On guiwei in the fifth month of summer the emperor posthumously raised Sima Yi to Prince Xuan of Jin and Sima Shi to Prince Jing of Jin.
units.literal: Summer, fifth month, day guiwei, the Son of Heaven posthumously added Wuyang Marquis Xuanwen as Jin King Xuan, Wuyang Marquis Zhongwu as Jin King Jing.

units.zh: 秋七月，帝奏司空荀顗定禮儀，中護軍賈充正法律，尚書僕射裴秀議官制，太保鄭沖總而裁焉。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn he charged Xun Yi with the rites, Jia Chong with the laws, Pei Xiu with the bureaucracy, and Zheng Chong as coordinator over all.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, the Emperor memorialized Minister of Works Xun Yi to fix rites and ceremonies, Central Army Protector Jia Chong to rectify laws and statutes, Vice Director of the Secretariat Pei Xiu to deliberate official system, Grand Guardian Zheng Chong overall to judge them.

units.zh: 始建五等爵。
units.en: He began the institution of the five orders of nobility.
units.literal: For the first time established the five ranks of nobility.

units.zh: 冬十月丁亥，奏遣吳人相國參軍徐劭、散騎常侍水曹屬孫彧使吳，喻孫皓以平蜀之事，致馬錦等物，以示威懷。
units.en: On dinghai in the tenth winter month he memorialized to send Xu Shao and Sun Yu—Wu natives in his service—to Wu with horses and brocade, to tell Sun Hao of Shu’s fall and to blend threat with kindness.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dinghai, memorialized to send Wu man Chancellor of State Army Advisor Xu Shao, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary Water Bureau Subordinate Sun Yu as envoys to Wu, informing Sun Hao of the affair of pacifying Shu, presenting horses, brocade, and such objects, in order to show awe and cherishing.

units.zh: 丙午，天子命中撫軍新昌鄉侯炎為晉世子。
units.en: On bingwu the emperor named Sima Yan, the Central Stabilizing General and Marquis of Xinchang township, heir apparent of Jin.
units.literal: On bingwu, the Son of Heaven ordered Central General Who Stabilizes the Army, village marquis of Xinchang Yan, to be Jin heir apparent.

units.zh: 二年春二月甲辰，朐䏰縣獻靈龜，歸於相府。
units.en: On jiachen in the second month of spring, the second year, Quren County sent up a sacred tortoise to the chancellor’s residence.
units.literal: Second year, spring, second month, day jiachen, Quren County presented a numinous tortoise; it was sent to the chancellor's mansion.

units.zh: 夏四月，孫皓使紀陟來聘，且獻方物。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer Sun Hao sent Ji Zhi on a goodwill embassy with tribute.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, Sun Hao sent Ji Zhi to come on friendly mission, and also present local products.

units.zh: 五月，天子命帝冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根車，駕六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鐘虡宮懸，位在燕王上。
units.en: In the fifth month the emperor granted him the twelve-tassel crown, imperial banners, cleared roads for his comings and goings, the gold-wheeled carriage drawn by six horses, five seasonal escort chariots, yak-tail and cloud banners, eight rows of dancers, bell-chimes in the palace style, and precedence above the Prince of Yan.
units.literal: Fifth month, the Son of Heaven ordered the Emperor's crown twelve tassels, erected Son of Heaven banners and flags, going out cleared roads entering cordoned progress, riding gold-root carriage, driving six horses, prepared five-seasons secondary carriages, set up yak-tail pennants and cloud-net banners, music and dance eight rows, established bell-stands palace suspended music, rank above the Prince of Yan.

units.zh: 進王妃為王后，世子為太子，王女王孫爵命之號皆如帝者之儀。
units.en: His consort became queen, his heir crown prince, and the titles for his daughters and grandsons matched those of the imperial house.
units.literal: Advanced the prince's consort to queen, heir apparent to crown prince; prince's daughters and grandsons' noble title commands all as the Son of Heaven's ritual.

units.zh: 諸禁網煩苛及法式不便於時者，帝皆奏除之。
units.en: He memorialized to repeal every harsh prohibition and obsolete statute that burdened the times.
units.literal: Various prohibitions, nets, vexing harshness, and legal models not convenient to the age—the Emperor all memorialized to remove them.

units.zh: 晉國置御史大夫、侍中、常侍、尚書、中領軍、衛將軍官。
units.en: The state of Jin was given a full set of offices—censor-in-chief, attendants, secretariat directors, central army supervisor, and general of the guard.
units.literal: The Jin state established Censor-in-chief, Palace Attendant, Regular Attendant, Director, Central Army Supervisor, General of the Guard offices.

units.zh: 秋八月辛卯，帝崩於露寢，時年五十五。
units.en: He died in the open hall on xinmao in the eighth month of autumn, aged fifty-five.
units.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day xinmao, the Emperor died in the open hall; at the time his years were fifty-five.

units.zh: 九月癸酉，葬崇陽陵，諡曰文王。
units.en: On guiyou in the ninth month he was buried at Chongyang Mausoleum with the posthumous title Wen, the Cultured King.
units.literal: Ninth month, day guiyou, buried at Chongyang Mausoleum; posthumous name King Wen.

units.zh: 武帝受禪，追尊號曰文皇帝，廟稱太祖。
units.en: When Sima Yan took the throne, Sima Zhao was posthumously raised to Emperor Wen with the temple name Taizu.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, posthumously honored title as Emperor Wen, temple called Taizu.

units.zh: 史臣曰：世宗以睿略創基，太祖以雄才成務。
units.en: The historians write: Emperor Shi founded the enterprise with cunning strategy, and Emperor Tai completed it with heroic force.
units.literal: The history official says: Shizong by keen strategy founded the base; Taizu by heroic talent completed the task.

units.zh: 事殷之跡空存，翦商之志彌遠，三分天下，功業在焉。
units.en: The mask of serving the house of Cao grew ever thinner while the will to supplant it burned brighter; they split the realm three ways, and there lay their achievement.
units.literal: The traces of serving Yin empty survive; the intent to cut Shang grows more distant; dividing three parts the realm, merit and enterprise lie therein.

units.zh: 及逾劍銷氛，浮淮靜亂，桐宮胥怨，或所不堪。
units.en: They crossed the Sword Gates to end the fog of war, rode the Huai to crush revolt—yet the bitterness of the Tong-palace depositions was more than some could stomach.
units.literal: When it came to crossing the sword to dispel miasma, floating the Huai to quiet rebellion, Tong Palace all resented—perhaps what could not be borne.

units.zh: 若乃體以名臣，格之端揆，周公流連於此歲，魏武得意於茲日。
units.en: Set beside the great ministers of old and the chief arbiters of policy, their course recalls the Duke of Zhou’s long season of care and the day Cao Cao seized his own triumph.
units.literal: If then embodying by famous ministers, patterning by chief ministers—Duke of Zhou lingered in this year, Wei Wu was pleased on this day.

units.zh: 軒懸之樂，大啟南陽，師摯之圖，於焉北面。
units.en: The graded bells of state sounded from Nanyang, and the royal musicians turned their registers toward the northern court.
units.literal: Suspended hall music, greatly opened Nanyang; Master Zhi's chart, thereupon faced north.

units.zh: 壯矣哉，包舉天人者也！
units.en: Magnificent—they took Heaven and humanity both in their grasp!
units.literal: Grand indeed! They who wrap and raise Heaven and man!

units.zh: 為帝之主，不亦難乎。
units.en: Small wonder that holding the title of emperor proved no easy thing.
units.literal: To be lord of emperors—is it not also difficult?

units.zh: 贊曰：世宗繼文，邦權未分。
units.en: The encomium reads: Emperor Shi followed the cultured king, while the power of the state still hung undivided.
units.literal: The eulogy says: Shizong continued Wen; state power not yet divided.

units.zh: 三千之士，其從如雲。
units.en: Three thousand retainers followed them like clouds.
units.literal: Three thousand gentlemen—their following like clouds.

units.zh: 世祖無外，靈關靜氛。
units.en: When Emperor Wu Sima Yan came, no foe stood beyond the pale and the sacred passes fell still.
units.literal: Shizu without those outside; spirit passes quiet miasma.

units.zh: 反雖討賊，終為弑君。
units.en: Though they struck in the name of punishing traitors, in the end they slew their king.
units.literal: Although turning back punished bandits, in the end it was regicide of the lord.
